title: Concept: Maven repository checksum failures ignored
description: pom.xml declares a repository whose checksum policy is `ignore`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A corrupted or substituted artifact installs without any warning, which removes the one integrity check Maven performs.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: A corrupted or substituted artifact installs without any warning, which removes the one integrity check Maven performs.
